zara-people-ops: Quick question for payroll/benefits: during the upcoming vendor migration some employees want to change elective deferrals retroactively for the current quarter. Is that allowed if the change request comes after the payroll file has been sent but before the funds reach the new vendor? @ben-payroll @olivia-benefits :wave:

ben-payroll: Short answer: retro changes are possible but depend on timing. If payroll file already transmitted to the bank, we can't amend that cycle. If it's still in staging we can hold and update. Best practice: employee signs a retro amendment and we submit RD401K_RETRO with the original payroll period.

olivia-benefits: To add: vendor requires an employee-signed amendment plus payroll confirmation of the amount and period. We also need to know if the retro impacts employer match calculations for that period. Match adjustments are allowed but vendor charges an admin fee. Expect 2-3 pay cycles to show on the account.

zara-people-ops: Got it. How should managers advise employees who are mid-cycle and want to increase deferrals due to a one-time bonus that hit after payroll export?

ben-payroll: If bonus paid in the same pay period but after export, treat as off-cycle contribution. Use RD401K_OFFC and include bonus line details in the ticket. If employee wants pretax vs Roth split different for the bonus, include that split in the ticket or it will default to pretax.

olivia-benefits: Note on taxes: retro changes and off-cycle bonus allocations can create W-2 adjustments. Employees should be informed. We will attach an explanation form to the ticket to capture their acknowledgement.

chris-finance: Finance ask: please cc finance on any RD401K_RETRO or RD401K_OFFC tickets. These create liability timing differences we need to reserve for month-end. Also include estimated fee amounts if vendor charges for retro processing.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Provider migration blackout: 2026-07-10 20:00 PT -> 2026-07-12 04:00 PT. Only urgent payroll tickets accepted. See: https://benefits.example.com/migration-notice

zara-people-ops: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a short FAQ and a ticket template for managers that explains RD401K_OFFC vs RD401K_RETRO and the approval steps. Posting to handbook later today. Any last items? :memo:
